meta.name: migrate-nanoclaw
meta.description: Extracts user customizations from a fork, generates a replayable migration guide, and upgrades to upstream by reapplying customizations on a clean base. Replaces merge-based upgrades with intent-based migration.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把分叉代码升级到上游版本并保留自定义修改
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你维护上游项目的分叉,想在不丢失自定义改动的前提下完成升级。
copy.tagline_en: Upgrade your fork to upstream while keeping your custom changes.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you maintain a fork and want to upgrade without losing your custom changes.

howto.what: 当你升级自己的 NanoClaw fork 时,它先把你的定制提取成一份 markdown 迁移指南,再在干净的上游 worktree 上重新应用这些定制,从而不靠 git merge 完成升级。
howto.when: 当你想把自己的 NanoClaw fork 升级到上游版本时;若已有迁移指南,它会问你是跳过提取直接升级,还是先更新指南。若改动很小,它会建议改用 /update-nanoclaw。

say.text: 帮我把这个 NanoClaw fork 升级到最新上游版本
say.note: 先做 preflight 和工作区检查,再进提取流程。

say.text: 我的定制都改了哪些地方,生成一份迁移指南
我装了 add-slack 之后又改过它,迁移时留意
say.note: 改动会单列写进指南的对应小节。

howto.what_en: It extracts your fork's customizations into a replayable markdown migration guide, then upgrades to upstream by re-applying them on a clean worktree, so no git merge conflicts.
howto.when_en: When you want to upgrade your NanoClaw fork to upstream; if a guide already exists it offers to skip ahead to the upgrade or refresh the guide first.

say_en.text: Upgrade this NanoClaw fork to the latest upstream version
say_en.note: Runs preflight checks, then starts extraction.

say_en.text: What did I customize? Write me a migration guide
I modified add-slack after applying it — note that
say_en.note: That change gets its own section in the guide.
